No `after_plan` hooks. Phase 1 design is complete. Per our workflow, **this is the plan gate — please review before we break it into tasks or build.**

## 🛠️ Implementation Plan ready for review

- **Plan**: `specs/001-bookmark-manager/plan.md`
- **Artifacts**: `research.md`, `data-model.md`, `contracts/api.md`, `quickstart.md`
- **Constitution check**: PASS (constitution is an unpopulated template — no gates to enforce; plan follows simplicity/testability defaults)

### The approach in plain terms

**One small web app, no external services.** A single Node.js server both serves the web page and answers data requests, and bookmarks are stored in a local database file so they survive restarts.

| Area | Choice | Why |
|---|---|---|
| **Stack** | Node.js + Express, plain HTML/CSS/JS front-end | No build step; simple and inspectable |
| **Storage** | SQLite file under `data/` | Survives reloads (SC-002); no server to run; real queries for tags/search |
| **Addresses** | Standard URL parser, `http`/`https` only, normalized | Rejects bad links (SC-004); reliable duplicate detection (FR-009) |
| **Page titles** | Fetched best-effort on save (~5s cap), falls back to the address | Never blocks or fails a save (FR-003) |
| **Search & tags** | Handled server-side | Finds one of 100 in seconds (SC-003) |
| **Testing** | `node:test` (unit) + Playwright 1.61.0 (end-to-end) | Covers the acceptance scenarios |

### How it maps to your app

- **API**: list/create/edit/delete bookmarks, list tags — with keyword search (`q`) and tag filtering built into the list endpoint (see `contracts/api.md`).
- **UI**: a bookmark list with an add form, inline edit, delete-with-confirmation, tag filter chips, and a search box — plus distinct "empty" vs "no results" states.
- **Data**: `Bookmark` (url, title, timestamps) ↔ `Tag` many-to-many.

### Notable decisions to confirm

1. **Vanilla front-end** (no React/framework) to keep v1 lightweight — good, or would you prefer a framework?
2. **SQLite file** for storage (single-user, local) — fits the "no external service" environment; acceptable?
3. **Plain substring search** (not full-text indexing) — sufficient at v1 scale; fine to start here?

---

**How would you like to proceed?**
- ✅ **Approve the plan** → I'll generate the task breakdown (`speckit-tasks`), then, on your go-ahead, implement.
- ✏️ **Request changes** → I'll revise the plan before moving on.
